reviewMethod: Projected pinned source polygons to EPSG:2154, measured all remainder components against only the INAO-listed commune, and visually inspected the overview and all three components.
finding: The 135.930216 m² remainder (0.178917%) is measured against Puligny-Montrachet only, the sole INAO commune. All three components were visually inspected against the unmodified pinned geometry: 122.831005 m² along the northern edge of the main cadastral block, 7.885774 m² on the southwest edge, and 5.213436 m² on the east edge. All touch the INAO boundary. Chassagne parcels remain neighbouring contacts even though both communes share a download bundle. The 136.0 m² cap allows less than 0.070 m² above the measurement. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered, filled or simplified; changed hashes require a new review.
